description: This file contains variable definitions, build rules, device configurations, and functions for building images and device-specific configurations for the Chromium OS platform targeting IPQ806x devices. It includes device migration info, build steps, and device profiles for ASUS OnHub and TP-Link OnHub.

methods.name: Device/dsa-migration
methods.description: Defines device compatibility and migration message for device configuration.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build rule to copy image file and append partition table using ptgen.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends the kernel partition to the image using dd.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Generates verified boot image using cros-vbutil.

methods.name: Device/OnhubImage
methods.description: Defines device-specific image variables and image composition steps for OnHub devices.

methods.name: Device/asus_onhub
methods.description: Device profile for ASUS OnHub, combining OnhubImage and device migration info, with device-specific identifiers.

methods.name: Device/tplink_onhub
methods.description: Device profile for TP-Link OnHub, combining OnhubImage and device migration info, with device-specific identifiers.
